home.title: Giza Pyramids View Guest House — all three pyramids from your balcony
home.desc: A family-run guest house on the 11th floor in Al Haram, Giza, with the three pyramids in the window, a roof terrace for breakfast and the Sphinx entrance a few minutes away. Enquire on WhatsApp.

rooms.title: Rooms — Giza Pyramids View Guest House
rooms.desc: Double and twin rooms with the pyramids in the window, a deluxe studio and a twin with a city view, each with air conditioning and a private bathroom. See the photos and enquire on WhatsApp.

gallery.title: Photos — Giza Pyramids View Guest House
gallery.desc: The pyramids at sunrise, noon, sunset and lit at night, the balcony, the gold lounge, the roof terrace and the rooms.

giza.title: Giza from the guest house — pyramids, Sphinx, museum, Saqqara
giza.desc: What is near the guest house: the Great Pyramid, the Sphinx entrance, the Grand Egyptian Museum, Saqqara, Dahshur, Khan el-Khalili and both airports, with distances and bearings.

enquire.title: Enquire — Giza Pyramids View Guest House
enquire.desc: Send your dates and room to the guest house on WhatsApp, or call +20 100 536 2094. Al Haram, Giza.

hero.title: All three pyramids, from your balcony
hero.lead: A family guest house eleven floors above Al Haram, with Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure in the window, breakfast on the roof and the Sphinx entrance a few minutes away.
hero.photoCaption: Sunset over the plateau, from the balcony

rooms.intro: Four kinds of room on one floor: two with the pyramids in the window, a deluxe studio, and a twin that looks over the city. Every room has air conditioning, a private bathroom and a fridge; breakfast is served on the roof.
rooms.stay: By the night, for a few days or a longer stay: ask us
rooms.bathroomText: Breakfast is served on the open roof terrace from seven to nine, with the plateau laid out in front of you; in the evening it is where guests sit for the sound-and-light show. Tea and coffee all day.

double-view.name: Double room, pyramids view
double-view.desc: A double bed and a single, a small table at the window and the three pyramids beyond the balcony railing. The room most guests write home about: wake up to Khufu, watch the sun go down between Khafre and Menkaure.

twin-view.name: Twin room, pyramids view
twin-view.short: Two beds, pyramids in the window
twin-view.desc: Two beds with velvet headboards and a window that frames the plateau. For friends, colleagues or a parent and child, with the same view as the double.

studio.name: Deluxe studio
studio.short: A queen bed and a sitting area
studio.desc: A queen bed with room to sit: a sofa, a table and the window onto the pyramids. The largest room on the floor, for a longer stay or a couple who wants space.

twin-city.name: Twin room, city view
twin-city.desc: Two single beds and a window over the rooftops of Al Haram. The simplest room, a few steps from the lounge and the roof where the view is.

view.d: “So beautiful, that it's powerful”, in one guest's words. All three pyramids, from the room, the lounge and the roof.

host.d: Guests name the staff in review after review. Write on WhatsApp and you deal with the people who run the house.

breakfast.d: Egyptian breakfast from seven to nine on the open terrace: ful, falafel, eggs, bread, cheese and fruit, with the pyramids.

location.d: The eastern entrance to the site is a short ride away; the Grand Egyptian Museum ten minutes by car.

tours.d: Airport pickup, Saqqara and Dahshur, Memphis, the museums: the house books cars and guides for a fee.

wifi.d: Free Wi‑Fi, air conditioning and a private bathroom in every room; a lift to the eleventh floor and someone at the desk all night.

view.title: What you see from the balcony
view.text: The guest house faces due west across the rooftops of Al Haram to the plateau. From left to right: Menkaure, the smallest; Khafre, which looks tallest because it stands on higher ground and still wears its casing at the top; and Khufu, the Great Pyramid. At sunset the sun drops between them.
view.captionNight: The sound and light show, nightly

gallery.intro: Swipe through the view at every hour, the balcony and lounge, the roof terrace and the rooms.

sunset.today: Sunset over the pyramids today at {time}, from the balcony.
sunset.show: The sound and light show starts after dark.

giza.intro: Giza is the pyramids, and the guest house sits right under them: the plateau is a short ride west, the Grand Egyptian Museum ten minutes north, and the metro to downtown Cairo fifteen minutes east. Saqqara, Dahshur and Memphis are a morning's trip south along the Nile.
giza.byAir: From Cairo Airport: about an hour by car across the city; the house arranges pickup. From Sphinx Airport: 40 minutes on the desert road.
giza.byMetro: Metro Line 2 to El Monib, then a short taxi ride down Al Haram road.
giza.byRoad: By car: Al Haram (Pyramids) Road from the Nile, turn south at Abd Al Aziz Al Basel Street.

enquire.title: Tell us your dates
enquire.text: Send the details below to the guest house on WhatsApp. Replies come in English or Arabic.
enquire.note: We are on the eleventh floor, building 4 on Abd Al Aziz Al Basel Street, off Pyramids Road. Write with your dates and how many of you there are, and we'll come back to you on WhatsApp with what's free. Tell us your flight if you'd like to be picked up.
